params.name: fromDate
params.description: Start of the date range (inclusive). Format: YYYY-MM-DD (ISO 8601). Defaults to toDate minus 30 days. Must be within the last 12 months. Maximum range with toDate: 365 days.

params.name: toDate
params.description: End of the date range (inclusive). Format: YYYY-MM-DD (ISO 8601). Defaults to today (UTC). Maximum range with fromDate: 365 days.

items.docs: Returns end-of-day balance snapshots across all account types for the authenticated user. History is available for the last 12 months. The maximum date range per request is 365 days.
